title: Unit 1: Past Simple in STAR Stories
subtitle: Cómo narrar tus proyectos y bugs pasados con precisión temporal
ruleSummary: En entrevistas, usa SIEMPRE Past Simple (built, refactored, resolved) para eventos en un momento específico del pasado (ej. 'in 2023', 'last quarter'). Usa Present Perfect (have worked) SOLAMENTE para experiencias sin fecha o que siguen activas hoy.

comparisonExamples.wrong: In 2023, I have redesigned our payment microservice.
comparisonExamples.right: In 2023, I redesigned our payment microservice.
comparisonExamples.tip: Una fecha concreta en el pasado (2023) exige Past Simple.

comparisonExamples.wrong: I work at this company since two years.
comparisonExamples.right: I have been working at this company for two years.
comparisonExamples.tip: Para estados continuados hasta hoy, usa Present Perfect Continuous con 'for'.

questions.prompt: When our Redis cluster crashed last month, I _____ the traffic to the fallback replica.
questions.contextSentence: STAR Situation/Action: Specific past event (last month).
questions.spanishExplanation: Con 'last month' (fecha específica), la regla exige Past Simple ('rerouted').
questions.audioText: When our Redis cluster crashed last month, I rerouted the traffic to the fallback replica.

questions.prompt: Throughout my career, I _____ distributed backends in Python and Go.
questions.contextSentence: General career experience with no specific past timestamp.
questions.spanishExplanation: 'Throughout my career' expresa experiencia acumulada; requiere Present Perfect.
questions.audioText: Throughout my career, I have built distributed backends in Python and Go.

questions.prompt: Yesterday the QA engineer _____ a critical memory leak in the parser.
questions.spanishExplanation: 'Yesterday' exige Past Simple ('identified'). Nunca 'has identified' con marcadores cerrados.
questions.audioText: Yesterday the QA engineer identified a critical memory leak in the parser.

questions.prompt: We _____ that legacy monolithic repository for over three years now.
questions.contextSentence: Ongoing activity starting in the past and continuing today.
questions.spanishExplanation: 'For over three years now' indica acción continuada hasta hoy (Present Perfect Continuous).
questions.audioText: We have been maintaining that legacy monolithic repository for over three years now.
